title: Kaikeyi enters the house of wrath
introduction: In this chapter, Kaikeyi enters the house of wrath. Dasaratha tries to pacify her anger.
closing: || इत्यार्षे स्रिमद्रामायणे अद्दिकाव्ये अयोध्य काण्दे दशम सर्गः ||
Thus completes tenth sarga of Ayodhya Kanda in Srimad Ramayana.

verses.devanagari:
विदर्शिता यदा देवी कुब्जया पापया भृशम् |
तदा शेते स्म सा भूमौ दिग्धविद्धेव किन्नरी
verses.iast:
vidarśitā yadā devī kubjayā pāpayā bhṛśam |
tadā śete sma sā bhūmau digdhaviddheva kinnarī
verses.translation: Having been thus wrongly preached by that sinful Manthara. Kaikeyi lied down on the floor as a Kinnara woman beaten by a poisoned arrow.

glosses.meaning: who was the most sinful person

verses.devanagari:
निश्चित्य मनसा कृत्यम् सा सम्यगिति भामिनी |
मन्थरायै श्नः सर्वमाच्चक्षे विचक्षणा
verses.iast:
niścitya manasā kṛtyam sā samyagiti bhāminī |
mantharāyai śnaḥ sarvamāccakśe vicakśaṇā
verses.translation: The skilful Kaikeyi, after deciding in mind what ought to be done told it all slowly to Manthara.

verses.devanagari:
सा दीना निश्चयं कृत्वा मन्थरावाक्यमोहिता |
नागकन्येव निःस्वस्य दीर्घमुष्णं च भामिनी
मुहूर्तं चिन्तयामास मार्गमात्मसुखावहम् |
verses.iast:
sā dīnā niścayaṃ kṛtvā mantharāvākyamohitā |
nāgakanyeva niḥsvasya dīrghamuśhṇaṃ ca bhāminī
muhūrtaṃ cintayāmāsa mārgamātmasukhāvaham |
verses.translation: Being stupefied by the words of Manthara, that Kaikeyi became dejected, made firm resolve, with deep and warm sigh, like a maiden-serpent and thought for that moment about the ways which can lead to her happiness.

glosses.meaning: stupefied by the words of Manthara
which can lead to her happiness.

verses.devanagari:
सा सुहृच्चार्थकामा च तं निशम्य सुनिश्चयम्
बभूव परमप्रीता सिद्धिं प्राप्येव मन्थरा |
verses.iast:
sā suhṛccārthakāmā ca taṃ niśamya suniścayam
babhūva paramaprītā siddhiṃ prāpyeva mantharā |
verses.translation: Manthara, who is Kaikeyi's companion and who is desirous of getting benefit, heard of Kaikeyi's firm resolve and became very much pleased as if she achieved success.

glosses.meaning: who is desirous of getting benefit

verses.devanagari:
अथ सा रुषिता देवी सम्यक्कृत्वा विनिश्चयम्
संविवेशाबला भूमौ निवेश्य भृकुटिं मुखे |
verses.iast:
atha sā ruśhitā devī samyakkṛtvā viniścayam
saṃviveśābalā bhūmau niveśya bhṛkuṭiṃ mukhe |
verses.translation: Kaikeyi, being angry and well determined, lied down on the floor with eye brows, knitted in her face.

verses.devanagari:
ततश्चित्राणि माल्यानि दिव्यान्याभरणानि च
अपविद्धानि कैकेय्या तानि भूमिं प्रपेदिरे |
verses.iast:
tataścitrāṇi mālyāni divyānyābharaṇāni ca
apaviddhāni kaikeyyā tāni bhūmiṃ prapedire |
verses.translation: Thereafter, she threw away her colourful chaplets and beautiful ornaments on to the floor.

verses.devanagari:
तया तान्यपविद्धानि माल्यान्याभरणानि च
अशोभयन्त वसुधां नक्षत्राणि यथा नभः |
verses.iast:
tayā tānyapaviddhāni mālyānyābharaṇāni ca
aśobhayanta vasudhāṃ nakśatrāṇi yathā nabhaḥ |
verses.translation: Those chaplets and ornaments which were thrown away by her were making the earth shine, as stars to the sky.

verses.devanagari:
क्रोधागारे निपतिता सा बभौ मलिनाम्बरा
एकवेणीं दृढं बद्ध्वा गतसत्त्वेव किन्नरी |
verses.iast:
krodhāgāre nipatitā sā babhau malināmbarā
ekaveṇīṃ dṛḍhaṃ baddhvā gatasattveva kinnarī |
verses.translation: Tying her single braid of hair tightly over her head and wearing soiled clothes, that Kaikeyi lying down in the chamber of wrath was looking like a Kinnara woman lying down dead.

verses.devanagari:
आज्ञाप्य तु महाराजो राघवस्याभिषेचन्म्
उपस्थासमनुज्ञाप्य प्रविवेश निवेशन्म् |
verses.iast:
ājJṇāpya tu mahārājo rāghavasyābhiśhecanm
upasthāsamanujJṇāpya praviveśa niveśanm |
verses.translation: King Dasaratha ordered for various arrangements to be made for Rama's coronation, took permission to leave from the elders who were present there and entered his palace.

verses.devanagari:
अद्य रामाभिषेको वै प्रसिद्ध इति जज्ञिवान्
प्रियार्हं प्रियमाख्यातुं विवेशान्तःपुरं वशी |
verses.iast:
adya rāmābhiśheko vai prasiddha iti jajJṇivān
priyārhaṃ priyamākhyātuṃ viveśāntaḥpuraṃ vaśī |
verses.translation: king Dasaratha, who kept all activates under his control entered into the inner chambers to tell the good news of Rama's coronation to Kaikeyi who was a worthy woman to be told the good news first (thinking that she has not yet heard the news).

glosses.meaning: Dasaratha who kept all activities under his control
to Kaikeyi who was a worthy woman to be told good news.

verses.devanagari:
स कैकेय्या गृहं श्रेष्ठं प्रविवेश महायशाः
पाण्डुराभ्रमिवाकाशं राहुयुक्तं निशाकरः |
verses.iast:
sa kaikeyyā gṛhaṃ śreśhṭhaṃ praviveśa mahāyaśāḥ
pāṇḍurābhramivākāśaṃ rāhuyuktaṃ niśākaraḥ |
verses.translation: That Dasaratha with vast glory entered Kaikeyi's chambers as moon enters the sky with white clouds.

verses.devanagari:
शुकबर्हिणसंयुक्तं क्रौञ्चहंसरुतायुतम्
वादित्ररवसंघुष्टं कुब्जावामनिकायुतम् |
लतागृहैश्चित्रगृहैश्चम्पकाशोकशोभितैः
दान्तराजत सौवर्णवेदिकाभिस्समायुतम् |
नित्यपुष्पफलैर्वृक्षैर्वापीभिश्चोपशोभितम्
दान्तराजतसौवर्णैः संवृतं परमासनैः |
विविध्यैरन्नपानैश्छ भक्ष्यैश्चवि विधैरपि
उपपन्नं महार्हैश्च भूषितैस्त्रिदिवोपमम् |
तत्प्रविश्य महाराजः स्वमन्तःपुरमृद्धिमत्
न ददर्श प्रियां राजा कैकेयीं शयनोत्तमे |
verses.iast:
śukabarhiṇasaṃyuktaṃ krauJṇcahaṃsarutāyutam
vāditraravasaṅghuśhṭaṃ kubjāvāmanikāyutam |
latāgṛhaiścitragṛhaiścampakāśokaśobhitaiḥ
dāntarājata sauvarṇavedikābhissamāyutam |
nityapuśhpaphalairvṛkśairvāpībhiścopaśobhitam
dāntarājatasauvarṇaiḥ saṃvṛtaṃ paramāsanaiḥ |
vividhyairannapānaiścha bhakśyaiścavi vidhairapi
upapannaṃ mahārhaiśca bhūśhitaistridivopamam |
tatpraviśya mahārājaḥ svamantaḥpuramṛddhimat
na dadarśa priyāṃ rājā kaikeyīṃ śayanottame |
verses.translation: King Dasaratha entered his magnificent palace but could not find his beloved kaikeyi on her best couch there. Peacocks and parrots were being reared in that palace, sounds of birds like curlews, and swans were heard around. The place was resonant with sounds of musical instruments. Short and hunch-backed maid-servants were moving here and there. There were bowers surrounded with creepers and lovely champaka and Ashoka trees. There were painted rooms. There were altars built with ivory, silver and gold. There were trees yielding flowers and fruits in all seasons and wells in the middle. There were beautiful seats constructed with ivory, silver and gold. Various types of food, drinks and snacks were made available. That palace was looking like heaven with beautifully adorned women.

glosses.meaning: filled with sounds of birds like curlews and swans
resonant with sounds of musical instruments
consisting of short and hunch backed maid servants
with lovely champaka and ashoka trees

verses.devanagari:
स कामबलसंयुक्तो रत्यर्थं मनुजाधिपः
अपश्यन् दयितां भार्यां पप्रच्छ विषसाद च |
verses.iast:
sa kāmabalasaṃyukto ratyarthaṃ manujādhipaḥ
apaśyan dayitāṃ bhāryāṃ papraccha viśhasāda ca |
verses.translation: Being possessed of power of lust, that king who came with object of sexual pleasure, was distressed in not finding his beloved wife and enquired the people there.

glosses.meaning: being possessed of power of lust

verses.devanagari:
न ही तस्य पुरा देवी तां वेळामत्यवर्तत
न च राजा गृहं शून्यं प्रविवेश कदाचन |
verses.iast:
na hī tasya purā devī tāṃ veLāmatyavartata
na ca rājā gṛhaṃ śūnyaṃ praviveśa kadācana |
verses.translation: In former times, Kaikeyi did not keep away herself at that kind of hour, nor the king enter her chambers at any time without her presence.

verses.devanagari:
ततो गृहगतो राजा कैकेयीं पर्यपृच्छत
यथापुरमविज्ञाय स्वार्थलिप्सुमपण्डिताम् |
verses.iast:
tato gṛhagato rājā kaikeyīṃ paryapṛcchata
yathāpuramavijJṇāya svārthalipsumapaṇḍitām |
verses.translation: After entering the house, king Dasaratha enquired with the aid-servants there as before, without knowing about foolish Kaikeyi who desired to get her selfish ends.

glosses.meaning: who desired to get her selfish ends.

verses.devanagari:
प्रतीहारी त्वथोवाच संत्रस्ता तु क्ऱ्^ताञ्जलिः
देव देवी भृशं कृद्धा क्रोधागारमभिद्रुता |
verses.iast:
pratīhārī tvathovāca santrastā tu kR^tāJṇjaliḥ
deva devī bhṛśaṃ kṛddhā krodhāgāramabhidrutā |
verses.translation: Then, a female door-keeper fearfully folding her hands in supplication, said: "Oh, king! The queen ran to her chamber of wrath with much anger".

verses.devanagari:
प्रतीहार्या वचः श्रुत्वा राजा परमदुर्मनाः
विषसाद पुनर्भुयो लुलितव्याकुलेन्ध्रियः |
verses.iast:
pratīhāryā vacaḥ śrutvā rājā paramadurmanāḥ
viśhasāda punarbhuyo lulitavyākulendhriyaḥ |
verses.translation: That Dasaratha having much disturbed mind already for the absence of Kaikeyi there, became more dejected after hearing the words of door-keeper.

verses.devanagari:
तत्रतां पतितां भूमौ शयानामतथोचिताम्
प्रतप्त इव दुःखेन सोऽपश्यज्जगतीपतिः |
verses.iast:
tatratāṃ patitāṃ bhūmau śayānāmatathocitām
pratapta iva duḥkhena so'paśyajjagatīpatiḥ |
verses.translation: King Dasaratha, after seeing Kaikeyi lying down on floor in the chamber of wrath, became tormented with grief.

verses.devanagari:
स वृद्धस्तरुणीं भार्यां प्राणेभ्योऽपि गरीयसीम्
अपापः पापसङ्कल्पां ददर्श धरणीतले |
लतामिव विनिष्कृत्तां पतितां देव तामिव
किन्नरीमिव निर्धूतां च्युतामप्सरसं यथा |
मायामिव परिभ्रष्टां हरिणीमिव संयताम्
verses.iast:
sa vṛddhastaruṇīṃ bhāryāṃ prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasīm
apāpaḥ pāpasaṇ^kalpāṃ dadarśa dharaṇītale |
latāmiva viniśhkṛttāṃ patitāṃ deva tāmiva
kinnarīmiva nirdhūtāṃ cyutāmapsarasaṃ yathā |
māyāmiva paribhraśhṭāṃ hariṇīmiva saṃyatām
verses.translation: That Dasaratha, who was sinless, a youthful woman dearer than his life, lying down on the floor with an intent to do sin. At that time, she was looking like a completely uprooted creeper, like a fallen angel, like a thrown down Kinnara woman, like an expelled divine dancer Apsarasa, like a dropped off illusionism and like a female deer tied up in a net.

glosses.meaning: with a desire to do sin

verses.devanagari:
क्रेणुमिव दिग्धेन विद्धां मृगयुना वने |
महागज इन्वारण्ये स्नेहात्परिममर्श ताम्
verses.iast:
kreṇumiva digdhena viddhāṃ mṛgayunā vane |
mahāgaja invāraṇye snehātparimamarśa tām
verses.translation: That Dasaratha touched Kaikeyi affectionately, as a great elephant in a forest touches a female elephant which is wounded by poisoned arrow.

verses.devanagari:
परिमृश्य च पाणिभ्यामभिसंत्रस्तचेतनः |
कामी कमलपत्राक्षीमुवाच वनितामिदम्
verses.iast:
parimṛśya ca pāṇibhyāmabhisantrastacetanaḥ |
kāmī kamalapatrākśīmuvāca vanitāmidam
verses.translation: That Dasaratha, possessed with infatuation and having fearful mind, touched that lotus-eyed woman with his hands and spoke the following words.

verses.devanagari:
न तेऽहमभिजानामि क्रोधमात्मनि संश्रितम् |
देवि केनाभिशप्तासि केन वासि विमानिता
यदिदं ममम् दुःखाय शेशे क्ल्याणि पांसुषु |
verses.iast:
na te'hamabhijānāmi krodhamātmani saṃśritam |
devi kenābhiśaptāsi kena vāsi vimānitā
yadidaṃ mamam duḥkhāya śeśe klyāṇi pāṃsuśhu |
verses.translation: "Oh queen, of auspicious qualities! I do not know that you are angry with me. Who has cursed or disrespected you? I am pained to see you resting in this way on a dirty floor."

glosses.meaning: this has become cause for my pain

verses.devanagari:
भूमौ शेषे किमर्थं त्वं मयि कल्याणचेतसि |
भूतोपहतचित्तेव मम चित्तप्रमाथिनी
verses.iast:
bhūmau śeśhe kimarthaṃ tvaṃ mayi kalyāṇacetasi |
bhūtopahatacitteva mama cittapramāthinī
verses.translation: "when I am here to expend all good to you, why are you hurting my mind by lying down on the floor like the one who is possessed of a devil."

glosses.meaning: when I have a good sense of mind
like one who is possessed of a devil.

verses.devanagari:
सन्ति मे कुशला वैद्यास्त्वभितुष्टाश्च सर्वशः |
सुखितां त्वां करिष्यन्ति व्याधिमाचक्ष्व भामिनि
verses.iast:
santi me kuśalā vaidyāstvabhituśhṭāśca sarvaśaḥ |
sukhitāṃ tvāṃ kariśhyanti vyādhimācakśva bhāmini
verses.translation: "There are so many royal physicians who are skilled and famous on all sides. They can make you healthy. Tell me your sickness".

glosses.meaning: and who are enlogised on all sides

verses.devanagari:
कस्य वा ते प्रियं कार्यं केन वा विप्रियं कृतम् |
कः प्रियं लभतामद्य को वा सुमहदप्रियम्
verses.iast:
kasya vā te priyaṃ kāryaṃ kena vā vipriyaṃ kṛtam |
kaḥ priyaṃ labhatāmadya ko vā sumahadapriyam
verses.translation: "To whom do you want a favour to be done? who has offended you? Tell me to whom I have to extend a favour now and to whom I have to do a great offensive act."

glosses.meaning: by you? kena vaa = by whom

verses.devanagari:
मा रोदीर्मा च कार्षिस्त्वं देवि संपरिशोषणम्
अवध्यो वध्यतां को वा को वा वध्यो विमुच्यताम् |
दरिद्रः को भवेदाढ्यो द्रव्यवान्वाप्यकिञ्चनः
verses.iast:
mā rodīrmā ca kārśhistvaṃ devi sampariśośhaṇam
avadhyo vadhyatāṃ ko vā ko vā vadhyo vimucyatām |
daridraḥ ko bhavedāḍhyo dravyavānvāpyakiJṇcanaḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, Kaikeyi! Do not weep and get your body dried up. If you tell, I shall kill a person who is exempt from death or shall release a person who is worthy to be killed. I shall make a poor man prosperous or a rich man, destitute".

glosses.meaning: is to be released? kovaa = who
wealthy? dravyavaanvaapi = or a rich man

verses.devanagari:
अहं चैव मदीयाश्च सर्वे तव वशानुगाः |
न ते किंचिदभिप्रायं व्याहन्तुमहमुत्सहे
verses.iast:
ahaṃ caiva madīyāśca sarve tava vaśānugāḥ |
na te kiṃcidabhiprāyaṃ vyāhantumahamutsahe
verses.translation: "I and all my people are submissive to you. I do not wish to foil even a little of your intention".

verses.devanagari:
आत्मनो जीवितेनापि ब्रुहि यन्मनसेच्छसि |
बलमात्मनि जानन्ती न मां शङ्कितुमर्हसि
करिष्यामि तव प्रीतिं सुकृतेनापि ते शपे |
verses.iast:
ātmano jīvitenāpi bruhi yanmanasecchasi |
balamātmani jānantī na māṃ śaṇ^kitumarhasi
kariśhyāmi tava prītiṃ sukṛtenāpi te śape |
verses.translation: "Tell me that which is desired by your mind to be achieved even at the cost of my life. You need not suspect me, as you very well know your authority over me. I keep my oath on my righteousness that I shall certainly do whatever is liked by you".

verses.devanagari:
यावदावर्त ते चक्रं तावती मे वसुन्धरा
प्राचीनाः सिन्धुसौवीराः सौराष्ट्रा दक्षिणापथाः |
वङ्गाङ्गमगधा मत्स्याः समृद्धाः काशिकोसलाः
verses.iast:
yāvadāvarta te cakraṃ tāvatī me vasundharā
prācīnāḥ sindhusauvīrāḥ saurāśhṭrā dakśiṇāpathāḥ |
vaṇ^gāṇ^gamagadhā matsyāḥ samṛddhāḥ kāśikosalāḥ
verses.translation: My jurisdiction over this earth stretches out as much to the extent as to the extent a chariot-wheel revolves. Eastern countries, Sindhu, Sauviira and Saurastra countries, as well as countries in the south, Vanga, Anga, Magadha and Matsya countries, Kasi and Kausala countries are all full of riches.

verses.devanagari:
तत्र जातं बहुद्रव्यं धनधान्य मजाविकम् |
ततो वृणीष्व कैकेयि यद्यत्त्वं मनसेच्छसि
verses.iast:
tatra jātaṃ bahudravyaṃ dhanadhānya majāvikam |
tato vṛṇīśhva kaikeyi yadyattvaṃ manasecchasi
verses.translation: In those countries, gold and grain, sheep and goats and all types of goods are produced. Oh, Kaikeyi! which of the goods do you want to acquire?

verses.devanagari:
किमायासेन ते भीरु उत्तिष्टोत्तिष्ट शोभने |
तत्वं मे ब्रूहि कैकेयि यतस्ते भयमागतम्
तत्ते व्यपनयिष्यामि नीहरमिव र्श्मिवान् |
verses.iast:
kimāyāsena te bhīru uttiśhṭottiśhṭa śobhane |
tatvaṃ me brūhi kaikeyi yataste bhayamāgatam
tatte vyapanayiśhyāmi nīharamiva rśmivān |
verses.translation: "Oh, fearful one! why are you exerted like this? oh, beautiful lady? Get up get up! Oh, Kaikeyi1 Tell me the source of your fear. I shall remove that source as sun sets aside the mist."

verses.devanagari:
तथोक्ता सा समास्वस्ता वक्तुकामा तदप्रियम्
परिपीडयितुं भूयो भर्तारमुपचक्रमे |
verses.iast:
tathoktā sā samāsvastā vaktukāmā tadapriyam
paripīḍayituṃ bhūyo bhartāramupacakrame |
verses.translation: Consoled by hearing the words of Dasaratha, Kaikeyi intending to tell unkindly words like Rama's exile was beginning to harass her husband further, by her words.
